verdict.rationale: Phoenix's first-party docs say it supports deterministic code-based evaluators, including custom heuristics alongside exact match and regex. They also describe Python and TypeScript SDKs that give full control over evaluation logic, and code-based checks can score traces, spans, experiment results and datasets. Missing for 10: no detailed docs or code examples showing how a custom scorer/metric is defined (function signature, score/label output shape), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of writing custom code evaluators.
